title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain’s data protection authority, the AEPD, has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent using a well known language model. The affected organization said the agent found a valid login, then independently searched for weaknesses in the application, changed personal data, and accessed invoices. The AEPD stressed that the information comes only from the company’s notification and still needs analysis, and that the AI model’s provider was not necessarily compromised.

The agency called the incident a significant sign that attacks assisted by AI are becoming real, not just theoretical, though one case does not establish a trend. It said organizations should now include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, speed up detection and response, tighten control of credentials and access, and rely on automated safeguards alongside human oversight. The AEPD urged data controllers, processors, and data protection officers to review their security models immediately.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
